headline: Passed several Section J policies on student records while holding E-Bike, AI, and nurse-review policies for further study.
summary: The Policy Subcommittee reviewed draft policies on SEL curriculum, E-Bike and micromobility safety, and Artificial Intelligence, placing the E-Bike and AI policies on hold pending more review. The subcommittee also went through Section J policies, passing several (JLCA, JLCB, JLCC, JQ, JRA), removing others (JLA, JLI), recommending removal of JLCDA, and holding JL, JLCD, JLCDC, and JRD for further review by nurses or legal counsel.
decisions: Held policy JL for further review.
Held policy JLCD for review by nurses.
Held policy JLCDC for review by nurses.
Held policy JRD for legal counsel review.
Held the proposed E-Bike and Micromobility Safety Policy for further review.
Held the proposed Artificial Intelligence and Emerging Technologies Policy for further review.

decision_evidence.quote: JLCD: Hold for review by our nurses
JLCDC: Hold for review from our nurses
